 "content": "def transform(grid):
    # A solid horizontal line separates two masks. Keep cells where both masks
    # are non-background, and render the overlap in color 2.
    sep = next(i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != 0)
    top = grid[:sep]
    bottom = grid[sep + 1:]
    return [[2 if top[r][c] != 0 and bottom[r][c] != 0 else 0
             for c in range(len(top[0]))] for r in range(min(len(top), len(bottom)))]
"
}
